text_block_list.name: Woman on Bench A
text_block_list.text:
“—And, it was seriously amazing!
She closed in super aggressively~!”

text_block_list.name: Woman on Bench B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're super loved, aren't ya!
And then what, and then what!?

text_block_list.name: Woman on Bench A
text_block_list.text:
And then, they got my lips and cheeks
all sticky and covered in kisses~... Ufufu♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
C-C-Could this be...
Girl talk about romance!? And the deep kind at that...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...J-Just a little.
I'll go to training after listening to just a little bit...!

text_block_list.name: Woman on Bench A
text_block_list.text:
...So, what do you think?
Isn't my doggy super cute?♪

text_block_list.name: Woman on Bench B
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm, just listening to you makes me so jealous!
Aww, I wanna get a doggie too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So it was... a dog, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, but if you just replace them with humans,
wasn't that actually a pretty good story...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Especially the part where she wakes up in the morning and he's crawled into her bed... I love that!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Phew~... Thank you for the meal.
Well then, shall we—
